PANJAB UNIVERSITY
DEPARTMENT OF BOTANY
CHANDIGARH-160 014, INDIA
(Established Under the Panjab University act of VII 1947-enacted by the Govt. of India)
Phone: +91-172-2534008; Fax: +91-172-2779510
Email: skupadhyay@pu.ac.in
Advertisement
Applications are invited for one post of Research associate (RA) in the Science & Engineering
Research Board (SERB) (renamed as ‘Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF)’)
sponsored research proposal entitled “Functional characterization of TaMSL5-D of bread wheat” to
be executed at the Department of Botany, Panjab University, Chandigarh with following terms and
conditions:
Position: RA – 1 (One)
Duration: 3 Months and co-terminus with the project (Project Completion Date : 19-Dec-
2024).
Emoluments: Rs 47,000 p.m. plus HRA.
Minimum Qualifications:
1. M.Sc. degree in Botany/Biotechnology/Life sciences with at least 55% marks.
2. Ph.D. in Botany/Biotechnology/ Life sciences with published research preferably on
gene cloning and functional characterization in plants.
Age limit: 40 and 45 years for male and female candidates, respectively.
Interested candidates to send their application by post, by hand or e-mail, along with complete
biodata and attested copies of the necessary certificates indicating the date of birth, marks in
qualifying examination, Masters and Ph.D award/ thesis submitted letter and research publications to
the undersigned by 20 August 2024.
Candidates will be shortlisted as per academic qualifications and research experience strictly relevant
to the project. The shortlisted candidates will be informed by mail and notice board of the
departmental website. The interview will be held on (date will be communicated later to shortlisted
candidates)….. 2024 from 11.00 AM in the Office of the Chairperson, Department of Botany, Panjab
University, Chandigarh. Candidates have to report along with the original certificates. No TA/DA
will be paid for attending the interview. The position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the
project.
(S K Upadhyay)
Principal Investigator
SERB (ANRF), Research Project
